title: NNTP reader session has no idle timeout — resource exhaustion under load
description: The SMTP session wraps every read_command_line call in tokio::time::timeout(command_timeout_secs). The NNTP reader's reader.read_line() call has no timeout — a client that connects and then idles holds a TCP fd, a tokio task, and a SessionContext allocation indefinitely. Scenario: 100 slow-loris connections idle after greeting, preventing legitimate readers from connecting once max_connections is hit (if enforced). SMTP already solved this with the existing config field; NNTP should apply the same pattern using the limits.command_timeout_secs equivalent.
